name: ambient-life-visual
description: Visual verification of ambient life (#458 T7.2/D12): bird flocks circling, chimney smoke over village houses, animated river/lake water, and wind-driven tree/grass sway rendering into the scene without error.

steps.description: A real (non-tutorial) level so the landscape zone is big enough to show tree cover, and any villages/rivers within camera range.

expect.note: dusty_hollow's own startingCash (Level.ts) is 50000, same as the sandbox default; worldSizeX increased confirms the level's own (larger) terrain actually replaced the sandbox one
